subject: How can I interrupt a running script in Renjin ?

messages.author: 6af7adb6cf4ce340
messages.subject: How can I interrupt a running script in Renjin ?
parts:
Dear Renjin developers,

Is there a way to cancel, interrupt a Renjin script ?

Best regards

Erwan

messages.author: f06db63329fab1f9
messages.subject: Re: How can I interrupt a running script in Renjin ?
parts:
Hi Erwan,
If you want to be able to cancel a running script, then I'd suggest running the calculation in a separate thread, which you can then interrupt. For example:


Runnable<SEXP> myCalc = new Runnable() {
  void run()
    ScriptEngine engine = /* create script engine */;
    engine.eval("mycalc()");
  }
}

Thread thread = new Thread(myCalc);
thread.start();

// Give the script one second to complete
thread.join(1000);

// If still running, interrupt
if(thread.isAlive()) {
  thread.interrupt();
}

The trick is that Renjin will only check the interrupt flag at certain points, for example, during I/O or when C package code calls R_CheckUserInterrupt(). 

We should also probably add more checks in the Java code, for example in long running loops. If there is a very time consuming computation in the Java code that you would like to be interruptable, then you can submit a pull request with code similar to:

if(Thread.interrupted()) {
  throw new EvalException("Interrupted.");
}
HTH,
Alex
